subject: InsightHealth — onboarding surcharge & starter pricing request
messages:
From: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@insighthealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding surcharge + starter pricing question

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency and the deployment options. Procurement asked me to follow up on two commercial items before we proceed to legal: 1) InsightHealth is asking for the onboarding surcharge to be waived for strategic pilots; 2) can you provide a cleaner starter rate for the first 6 months — our CFO has a short runway and wants predictability.

High level: we plan to start with a 6‑month pilot (expected 5M tokens/month) and then ramp to a committed annual tier if things go well. Can you put something in writing on what flexibility Redwood can offer?

Attachments: insight_health_usage_projection.xlsx (customer forecast)

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Dunn
Head of Product Operations, Insight Health
claire.dunn@insighthealth.com
procurement@insighthealth.com
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: InsightHealth — onboarding surcharge & starter pricing request (need exec signoff)

Team,

FWD of an inbound from Insight Health. Short ask from the customer: waive the onboarding surcharge for their 6‑month pilot and give a starter price (they asked for a ~20% effective discount for months 1–6). The attached forecast shows ~5M tokens/month during the pilot, with a likely conversion to a 12‑month committed tier at >50M/mo if pilot meets KPIs.

Why this matters: Insight is a strategic healthcare prospect (large payer network) and this pilot could lead to a dedicated deployment (Dedicated or Private) across multiple regions. My recommendation: grant a limited onboarding concession + conditional starter pricing to accelerate momentum, but require measurable guardrails and a light clawback.

Proposed exception (ask for VP/CFO signoff):
- Waive onboarding surcharge in full for pilot (one‑time).
- Starter price: 15% discount off published starter rate for months 1–6 (not compounding with other promos).
- Commit condition: convert to a 12‑month minimum at the end of pilot or repay onboarding waiver + prorated discount as a clawback.
- Payment: net‑30 on pilot invoices; for committed conversion require 60% upfront or 3‑month prepay.
- Limit exposure: cap total concession to $120k NRR impact in first 12 months.

Attachments I’m including: insight_health_usage_projection.xlsx, insight_health_contract_rfp.pdf, and a short exception memo (redwood_exception_memo_mateo_20270519.pdf) with ARR impact calc.

Ask: Marissa / Naomi — can you review? Naomi I need a quick math check on the $120k ceiling and suggested clawback structure. Karthik — if leadership okays this, I’ll send a formal commercial memo to the customer and request legal to produce a temporary amendment.

Thanks,
Mateo
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: insight_health_usage_projection.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_exception_memo_mateo_20270519.pdf (internal impact brief)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: InsightHealth — onboarding surcharge & starter pricing request (need exec signoff)

Mateo / team — thanks for the note and the ARR sketch. I agree in principle — this looks like a high‑leverage pilot. A few suggested guardrails to reduce revenue risk:

- Replace an open 15% front‑loaded discount with a 10% starter credit applied as a rebate on the first two invoices (keeps headline price less discounted but preserves unit economics).
- Approve full onboarding waiver only if customer signs the pilot amendment within 10 business days; otherwise onboarding fee applies retroactively.
- Add churn trigger: if usage falls below 60% of forecast in two consecutive months, the waiver is void and discounts are reclaimed.
- Require procurement to acknowledge a minimum conversion window (we prefer 12 months post‑pilot).

If Finance can live with the $120k cap/conditional rebate model, I’ll lock this as the commercial stance and prepare the go‑to‑legal memo + DocuSign flow. Also recommend we tie the approval to a HubSpot deal update (deal id attached).

– Karthik
VP, North America Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: InsightHealth — onboarding surcharge & starter pricing request (need exec signoff)

Thanks for the clear memo, Mateo. I ran the numbers on the attached projection. Finance is willing to approve a bounded concession with the following conditions:

1) Approve a 100% onboarding surcharge waiver for the pilot period, capped at $50k. Any excess must be repaid if we do not hit the conversion condition.
2) Replace the proposed 15% up‑front discount with a 10% one‑time rebate applied to the first two invoices (equivalent to roughly 11–12% effective reduction across pilot given projected volumes).
3) Require a signed commercial amendment (DocuSign) within 10 business days of the pilot start. If not signed we retroactively invoice onboarding surcharge and the rebate is void.
4) Conversion requirement: commit to a minimum 12‑month renewal within 30 days of pilot end or repay onboarding waiver prorated over 12 months.
5) Clawback trigger: if consumption <60% of forecast for any two consecutive months during the pilot, we reserve the right to reclaim concessions pro rata.

If leadership (Marissa) is comfortable with the cap and clawback language above I’ll prepare the accounting entries and the amendment language. I’m marking expected GAAP impact in the internal memo at ~$95k in the first 12 months (conservative).

Attachments referenced: redwood_exception_memo_mateo_20270519.pdf (internal calc).

– Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: InsightHealth — onboarding surcharge & starter pricing request (need exec signoff)

Agree with Naomi’s conditions — approve the exception as outlined. Key points:

- Onboarding surcharge waiver approved (cap $50k) for the pilot only.
- Use the 10% two‑invoice rebate approach (keeps long‑term ARPU clearer).
- Require DocuSign amendment plus procurement acknowledgement of conversion window.
- Add an automatic review checkpoint at pilot month 3 (product & CS) to validate technical fit before conversion flows.

Mateo — proceed to send the formal commercial memo to Claire and start the DocuSign/Legal run (use HubSpot deal RH-78921-INSIGHT). Copy Naomi on the amendment. If procurement presses for deeper discounts, bring it back to me.

Marissa
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
